### Description

[wiki link](https://wiki.ewave.com/display/LEGO/Product+Attachment)

Product Attachments extension for Magento provides functionality for file downloads available within Product pages.
You can upload product manuals, guides. Attachment can be associated with multiple products.
Website administrator is able to:

  1. upload attachments;
  2. see all attachments in one grid in backend;
  3. enable / disable attachments;
  4. assign attachments to one or multiple products;
  5. specify an order for product attachments;
